summary: Okanogan NF lookout site at 7,403 ft: a camp in 1930 or 1931, a 12x12 cabin in 1932, removed in 1954; no source describes what remains today.

facts.status_note: Cabin removed in 1954 per FFLOS and WillhiteWeb; FireLookout.com says destroyed that year. No source describes what remains at the site today.

staffing.as_of: 1932 (last lookout named in the sources read)

access.note: No source we read describes how to reach the site

events.note: WillhiteWeb says there was a camp in 1930 and that Keith Johnson was the lookout from 1930 to 1932
The register dates the camp to 1931. WillhiteWeb says two men hauled lumber to the site that year for a lookout structure
Keith Johnson was the lookout through 1932, per WillhiteWeb
Panoramic images taken September 24, 1934, just after a large snowstorm
Cabin removed per FFLOS and WillhiteWeb; FireLookout.com says destroyed
Registered November 11, 2012, nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: Okanogan National Forest and Okanogan County location
Okanogan National Forest and Okanogan County location (FireLookout.com)
WillhiteWeb calls the site Point Defiance

evidence.quote: A camp set up in 1931 was replaced in 1932 with a 12'x12' frame cabin, which was removed in 1954.
In 1930 there was a camp. Keith Johnson was the lookout in 1930, 1931 and 1932.

evidence.supports: 1931 lumber hauled for a lookout structure
evidence.quote: In 1931, Dudley Helms and George Miller hauled lumber to Point Defiance for a lookout structure.
In 1932, a 12 x12 foot frame cabin was built.

evidence.supports: short-wave radio given to the site
evidence.quote: A short wave radio for sending and receiving was also given to the site.
On September 24, 1934, panoramic images were taken.

evidence.supports: large snowstorm just before the 1934 panoramas
evidence.quote: A large snowstorm had just hit
In 1954 the frame cabin was removed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says a camp was set up in 1931; WillhiteWeb says there was a camp in 1930. Not resolved; the story gives both.
The register and WillhiteWeb say the cabin was removed in 1954; FireLookout.com says destroyed in 1954. Both are reported; the record uses removed.
The register and FireLookout.com say Defiance Point; WillhiteWeb says Point Defiance. Both give 7,403 ft, so they are treated as one site.

notes_for_editor: The brief matches the register on coordinates, elevation and registration (November 11, 2012, nominated by Ray Kresek). The brief's FireLookout.com URL was malformed; the page was read at http://www.firelookout.com/wa/defiancepoint.html. Two searches found no description of the site today, so access is unknown and no visit facts are recorded. No corrections to the brief. Reads: 3 pages, 2 searches.
